newsitem.title: USA: Texas seen biggest growth state 1995-2000 - Census.
newsitem.headline: Texas seen biggest growth state 1995-2000 - Census.

text.p: Texas is expected to grow faster than any other state between 1995 and 2000, with a net population gain of 1.4 million people, the Commerce Department's Census Bureau said this week.

Rounding out the top five population growth states projected for the period are Florida, with 1.1 million; California, with 932,000; Georgia, with 674,000; and North Carolina with 582,000, a Census Bureau release said.

"Some states, particularly those expected to gain large numbers of people, will need to plan for adjustments in facilities and services--including schools and roads--to accomodate the increased population," Paul Campbell, author of the tabulations, said in the release.
